ref: Feigenbaum Teen Siddur, Nusach Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharis, Hashkamas Ha'boker, Netilas Yadayim
he: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר קִדְּ֒שָֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְצִוָּנוּ עַל נְטִילַת יָדָֽיִם:
text: OK but I need “tools” in order to apply all this wisdom and accomplish my goals!
You, Hashem, are the Source of everything;
and You rule the entire world; and through Your mitzvos You elevated
and You commanded us to wash our hands (and thus make sure we put meaning and thought into all we do). You, Hashem, are the Source of everything;

and You rule the entire world; You have formed humans with great wisdom (as scientists are continually discovering) and created within us all sorts of openings and cavities. It is quite obvious that even if just one of them would be torn or blocked it would be impossible for us to survive and stand in front of You (even for a second)! You, Hashem, are the Source of everything;
You heal all living things and perform constant miracles.
